info.name: Cinema Ticket System - API Collection
info.description:
Enterprise Cinema Ticket Reservation Backend API Collection (OpenAPI 2.0 / Swagger Compatible).

Key Capabilities Tested:
1. Health Check & Swagger Documentation Discovery
2. User Authentication & Role-Based JWT Token Generation (Admin & Customer)
3. Screening Schedule Management (Full CRUD)
4. Schedule Conflict Prevention Lab Scenarios (HTTP 409 Conflict vs HTTP 201 Created)
5. Security & RBAC Enforcement (HTTP 401 Unauthorized & HTTP 403 Forbidden)

Interactive Swagger UI: http://localhost:8088/swagger/index.html
Swagger JSON Spec: http://localhost:8088/swagger/doc.json

item.name: 4. Schedule Conflict Prevention Lab (HTTP 409 vs 201)
item.description: Deterministic test cases validating PostgreSQL btree_gist exclusion constraints and service-level collision prevention.

item.name: Scenario 1: Overlap Collision in Same Studio (Expect 409 Conflict)
